verdict.rationale: The Adyen Terminal API is explicitly documented as a server-driven JSON API that lets developers build custom POS integrations to make payments, issue refunds, and handle tipping, with test tools and an OpenAPI spec repo available (adyen-pos-docs-1, adyen-pos-docs-17, adyen-pos-docs-10, adyen-pos-docs-26, adyen-pos-gh-1). Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer corroboration confirming ease of use—one community anecdote (adyen-pos-comm-1) describes a difficult legacy card-present integration, though it doesn't concretely contradict the current documented Terminal API's server-driven design.
